author: reek
body: Reactive data binding. A Binding connects a DataSource to a target (a monitor panel, a widget, or a route endpoint). When the source updates, the binding propagates the new value. Bindings can transform values through a pipeline of steps: map, threshold, format, aggregate.

author: reek
body: This is what makes the monitor composable -- you don't wire each panel to a specific API call, you wire it to a binding that knows how to extract the value from whatever state slice owns it.
